name: client-storage-updatemetadata-root-ref
description: firebase/storage updateMetadata(ref(storage), patch) on the root reference: observes client-side invalid-root-operation preflight with zero network requests.

behavior.message: Firebase Storage: The operation 'updateMetadata' cannot be performed on a root reference, create a non-root reference using child, such as .child('file.png'). (storage/invalid-root-operation)
